case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

You wrote that you want to keep supporting our operations with reliable delivery, and a bundle with a binding volume does exactly that for your plant. The fastener kit would be business on top of what you supply us today, and Option A secures that steady load for your plant.

On the cost side:
Our forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc rises 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).

On the price history of the bolt:
Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

On the price history of the nut:
Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.18; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.13; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.15; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 36 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your plant a binding volume over a long contract term, and the price history shows how steady our business with you has been.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As this is a larger step for both family companies, please take Option A to the colleague who decides on pricing at your end, so that it can be approved as it stands.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As the authorized representative for this negotiation, I have reviewed your proposal and the historical data provided.

Our main offer stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

In exchange for the 36-month contract and 45-day payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €5.58 per unit. Alternatively, we also present an option with a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

You wrote that your price follows your main cost drivers, and we have taken that seriously. Our options give your plant a binding volume as business on top of what you supply us today, so the base price does not need to carry that uncertainty for you.

On the washer price history:
Our orders of Washer ISO 7089 M12, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2024-10-10 (po:4500011536-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2025-06-11 (po:4500012581-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-01-29 (po:4500013501-10) and EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-20): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.19; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.21; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.25; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 36 months.

Option A is the package we can approve: it secures steady load for your plant over the full contract term, and the washer history shows how stable our business with you has been.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Since this goes beyond a routine price change, would you please take Option A to the person who decides on your side? It gives your company a binding volume and a steady, planned workload for your plant, from a customer who has kept to its prices and orders with you for years.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
